en.title: ia in iarnă (winter)
en.summary: The diphthong ia is found in the Romanian word iarnă.

sections.title: The group ia
paragraphs: The letters ia sound like the name /ja/. Their main sound appears in (iarnă) /ˈjar.nə/, which means winter. This letter group makes two different sounds.

sections.title: Pronouncing the group
paragraphs: For the first sound, push your tongue high and forward. Then drop your jaw quickly to an open vowel. Your voice vibrates throughout the whole motion. For the second sound, make a full clear ee vowel first. Then open your mouth completely for a separate ah sound. Feel your throat buzz constantly with your fingers.

sections.title: Reading the spelling
paragraphs: When the two letters sit in the same syllable, they make the quick gliding sound /ja/, as in (băiat) /bəˈjat/. When the vowels split across two syllables, pronounce two distinct beats with the sound /i.a/, as in (pian) /piˈan/.

sections.title: Avoiding mistakes
paragraphs: Do not turn the gliding pair into two slow vowels. In words with one syllable, say it quickly like the sound in yard. Also, avoid changing the open vowel to the sound in cat. Keep the second vowel wide and open like the sound in father.
